title.narrative: UNDP/SEI Reform accelerator for EU chapter 27 environment and climate
UNDP/SEI Reform accelerator för EU kapitel 27 Miljö och klimat

description.narrative: Reformacceleratorn är utformad för att stödja Albaniens miljöministerium i förhandlingarna om kapitel 27 inom ramen för landets EU-anslutningsprocess. Initiativet syftar även till att underlätta genomförandet av nödvändiga reformer så att Albanien kan uppfylla kraven i Europeiska unionens regelverk för miljö och klimat. Detta innefattar stöd för kapacitetsuppbyggnad inom den ansvariga institutionen samt främjande av ett bredare engagemang och deltagande från det albanska samhället i reformprocessen.

The Reform Accelerator is designed to support Albania’s Ministry of Environment in the negotiations on Chapter 27 within the framework of the country’s EU accession process. The initiative also aims to facilitate the implementation of necessary reforms to enable Albania to comply with the European Union’s environmental and climate regulatory requirements. This includes supporting capacity building within the responsible institution as well as promoting broader engagement and participation of Albanian society in the reform process.

The project's overarching aim is to support Albania's structural transformation towards sustainable development by strengthening citizen-centric and environmentally responsible governance systems by
i) Strengthening Albania's environmental and climate governance framework to meet specific benchmarks under the EU acquis and
ii) Finance institutional initiatives that deliver medium to long-term impact on Albania's environmental and climate governance.
This is expressed as follows in the ToC:
overall objective: support Albanian institutions in advancing environmental and climate governance through legislation alignment, strategic planning, and implementation of the EU Chapter 27 acquis during the negotiation process.
a) The Ministry of Environment and other Chapter 27 institutions have progressed in meeting Albanias commitments for Chapter 27 negotiations.
b) Chapter 27 institutions have strengthened their capacity for strategic planning and implementation of Chapter 27 acquis.
